_readme: Maps each Journal essay to the analyzer focus its 'Check your own mix for this' CTA opens (analyze.html?check=<focus>). Resolution order: none -> overrides -> keywords (first match on the slug) -> hub_default -> fallback. Foci are implemented in js/analyze-focus.js and must exist there. Add a slug to 'none' only when the essay is not about something the analyzer measures (history, listening tests, pure workflow). Future essays need no edit: keywords and the hub default cover them.

lufs.line: Drop a bounce into the analyzer and read its integrated LUFS next to the −14 lane. It stays on your device.

tp.line: Drop a bounce into the analyzer and read its true peak and clipped samples against the −1.0 dBTP ceiling. It stays on your device.

mono.line: Drop a bounce into the analyzer and read its phase correlation, then audition the fold-down yourself. It stays on your device.

lowend.line: Drop a bounce, then a finished track you trust, and compare where the low end sits. It stays on your device.

tails.line: Drop the exported file and check its length and loudness the way a store will hear them, head and tail included. It stays on your device.

format.line: Drop the exported file and confirm its sample rate and channels before you upload it. It stays on your device.

clips.line: Drop a bounce into the analyzer and count its clipped samples. It stays on your device.

punch.line: Drop a bounce into the analyzer and read crest factor beside LUFS to see how much punch is left. It stays on your device.
